uutiset.s: The proposed fund structure brings together two things investors are obsessed with.

uutiset.t: BP Said to Weigh Divesting Its Key West Africa LNG Plant GTA
uutiset.s: BP Plc has been considering divesting its majority stake and operatorship of its liquefied natural gas facility off the coast of West Africa, people familiar with the matter said, as chief executive officer Meg O’Neill aims to narrow the energy major’s portfolio.

uutiset.t: Life Insurers Are Lagging in Private Markets Risk Assessments
uutiset.s: Life insurers haven't built up the same kind of skills to analyze private market investments in the same way as banks have and the lag compared with deployment is ``fairly significant'' in areas like credit risk assessment, valuation and capital allocation, according to Lukas Ziewer, a researcher an

uutiset.t: US Sour Crude’s War Premium Vanishes as Supply Surges
uutiset.s: The price of US sour oil has plunged, as a surge of oil from Venezuela, Canada and the Middle East gives refiners ample barrels to choose from.

uutiset.t: Banks Swap Battered Brazil for Mexico in Regional Equity Picks
uutiset.s: Banks from Wall Street to Brazil’s Faria Lima financial hub are switching their stock preferences to Mexico and away from Brazil as diverging growth, rates and earnings outlooks reshape the investment case across Latin America.

uutiset.t: South Africa Port Operator Blames Delays on Old Equipment
uutiset.s: The operator of South Africa’s biggest shipping container terminal blamed poor equipment upkeep for severe delays that have caused medical supply shortages and hit car exports, triggering threats it could lose its license.

uutiset.t: Algebris Hedges Against AT1 Volatility by Avoiding Tight Spreads
uutiset.s: Algebris Investments is taking a cautious approach to AT1 bonds as spreads remain historically tight, avoiding the most expensive parts of the market and keeping buffers against a potential downturn. uutiset.t: Alphabet to Raise at Least $3.5 Billion With Canadian Debt Sale
uutiset.s: Alphabet Inc. is returning to the Canadian market with a five-part bond sale, just six months after issuing its first notes in the currency.

uutiset.t: AMD Falls on Hunterbrook Short Call That Cites China Risks
uutiset.s: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. shares slid after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.

uutiset.t: Jetour vai investir R$ 400 mi para produzir no Brasil
uutiset.s: Leonardo Lara fala sobre o investimento da Jetour para estabelecer uma base de produção no Brasil. Edição de Gisele Fernandes (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff fueled by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.

uutiset.t: Sanofi Weighs Takeover of US Drugmaker Insmed
uutiset.s: Sanofi SA is weighing an acquisition of US drugmaker Insmed Inc., people familiar with the matter said, as the French pharmaceuticals company hunts for its next blockbuster treatment under a new CEO.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Jump 21% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares soared 21% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

uutiset.t: India Customs Dispute Holds Up $66 Million of Scotch Whisky
uutiset.s: Indian customs authorities are holding up bulk Scotch whisky shipments worth more than £50 million ($65.8 million) at various ports over an import duty dispute, said a person familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Latin American Currencies Tumble on Fed-Rate Hike Repricing
uutiset.s: A sell-off in Latin American currencies deepened Thursday, sending the Mexican peso to its lowest since June 2025 and forcing Brazil’s central bank to step in to prop up the real, adding to a sour mood as traders reprice the odds of US interest-rate hikes.
